lore: A gust caught the harbour office window and Wharf Clerk Godfrey's paperwork went everywhere. Every island in the census had two papers: its island card and its cargo manifest. They landed face down along the quay. Turn two at a time; when an island card and its own manifest come up together, clip them and set them aside. Godfrey remembers every paper he has seen. Can you?

lines.sharp: Every manifest clipped to its island, and not one wasted turn. You've a clerk's memory.
lines.matched: All filed, but you turned some papers you'd already seen. Remember where each one lies.
lines.unfinished: Papers still face down on the quay. Keep turning; the tide won't wait for the paperwork.
